answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make every agent lock a refundable stake and earn voting weight only from attested useful work. Like a quill that gains ink only after real writing, an identity counts only after peers verify its completed tasks against outputs. A sparrow of a new account, cheap to spawn, starts weightless, and each clone needs fresh stake plus fresh work. The pulse is delayed settlement: rewards release only after a window in which fraud proofs can slash the stake. Attackers thus pay capital and time per identity, while honest agents compound trust from work already done.
